style: English acoustic indie pop, warm female vocal, fingerpicked guitar, gentle piano, soft brushed drums, 90 BPM, intimate and hopeful
lyrics:
[Verse]
The streetlights fade, the kettle sings
We leave the night to other things

[Chorus]
Here comes the first light, soft and slow
A little more sky than we used to know

[Outro]
A little more sky
